Peter,

Working Texans deserve an inclusive democracy that respects the right to vote. But, our democracy is under attack, especially here in Texas. Here is just one of the latest headlines:
Texas Tribune headline reads: False allegations of voter fraud in 2020 led to increased threats against Texas election workers. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-20220818-casar?refcode=em-20220818]

Let’s be clear: no one should be threatened simply for helping others participate in the democratic process.

As long as right-wing extremists refuse to honor election results, suppress our voting rights, and spread false propaganda, our very democracy remains under threat.
That is why when Greg is in Congress, he’ll work with other progressives to pass federal legislation to build a truly inclusive and fair democracy in Texas.
Our team relies on small dollar donations from engaged supporters like you, Peter . Will you chip in what you can to help us continue to drive strong voter turnout across the district on Election Day? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-20220818-casar?refcode=em-20220818]

CHIP IN NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-20220818-casar?refcode=em-20220818]

Greg has a history of fighting for better access to voting in Texas. He worked to successfully double the number of voters in his city council district from 2014 to 2020. He also pushed for more voting locations in underserved areas, and successfully worked to change the law to allow more voters to participate in local elections.

In Congress, Greg has pledged to support federal legislation like the For the People Act and John Lewis Voting Rights Act, along with automatic voter registration. We need to get big money out of politics, end partisan gerrymandering, and hold those accountable who have incited violence against the Capitol and against election workers.
Elections matter up and down the ballot, Peter . Greg has a record of driving folks to the polls, but we do none of this work alone. Pushing for high voter turnout begins months before Election Day, and we need your help to get the word out. Please, will you chip in what you can to help our team continue to reach out to potential voters immediately? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-20220818-casar?refcode=em-20220818]

Together,
Team Casar

clean_body: There's still time to share with Kim what parts of the Inflation Reduction Act matter most to you Have you taken Kim's survey yet, Peter? The House passed the Inflation Reduction Act last week – a crucial bill that will: ✅ Reduce prescription drug prices ✅ Lower energy costs ✅ Deliver the largest ever investment in clean energy ✅ Make sure corporations are paying their fair share From lowering prescription drug costs and investing in climate solutions, this bill provides answers to the questions Kim has been hearing from her constituents. Now Kim wants to hear from you. \---------Begin Forwarded Message---------- Sender: Dr. Kim Schrier Subject: Lowering costs and protecting our planet Date: Wednesday, August 17, 2022 Team, Last week, I was proud to help pass the Inflation Reduction Act in the House. This is a historic health care and climate bill that is the answer to questions that Washingtonians have been asking since Day One. The Inflation Reduction Act will lower health care costs by capping the cost of insulin at $35 per month. It also allows Medicare to negotiate the cost of prescription drugs and caps out-of-pocket costs at $2,000 for those enrolled in Medicare drug plans. Not only will this bill lower health care costs for families, but it answers my constituents' questions about climate change by making the single largest investment in climate solutions ever. The Inflation Reduction Act will boost clean energy manufacturing in the U.S., invest in forest resiliency, and more. As families continue to struggle due to rising costs, this legislation will provide much needed relief while protecting our planet for generations to come. Now that President Biden has signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law, I want to hear from you. | Thank you, Kim To hold the House majority, we must re-elect Rep. Kim Schrier in WA-08. Will you chip in to protect Kim's seat and the Democratic House majority in 2022? = Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress Contributions or gifts to Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress are not tax deductible. New Hampshire Republicans are posed for greatness

name: Rep. Val Demings
subject: Nothing has been easy for me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
But I'm determined to meet this moment
| | |
---
Friend: Each and every day it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.
But I know a thing or two about persevering, and _winning_ , even when the odds are stacked against me.
I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. **There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South.** But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today.
I carry the spirit of her words with me even still – as I reflect on my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49420014/362067326/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4082-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjRlNWIwNy0yODFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nfaWCBtWQtOwqYnUDZGoGnO49C86XWjcyNfZ5fUaw2w=)
**There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate** – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
And friend, I know firsthand there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate, because no one should be above the law.
My road to this moment was not easy. But I'm not sure that there’s anywhere except America where a little Black girl – the daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the '60s South – could have a story so filled with opportunities like these. And I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good, so that anyone can have a story of opportunity.
This may be my toughest challenge yet, which is why I'm urging you – every last person reading this email – to chip in whatever you can to ensure I have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and win in Florida: [**Please, will you give $5 or more to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? Every dollar you give increases our ability to compete and win this tough battleground race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49420015/362067327/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4082-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjRlNWIwNy0yODFmLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nfaWCBtWQtOwqYnUDZGoGnO49C86XWjcyNfZ5fUaw2w=)
With so much gratitude for all you do,

Val Demings

clean_body: But I'm determined to meet this moment | | | Friend: Each and every day it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy. But I know a thing or two about persevering, and winning , even when the odds are stacked against me. I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today. I carry the spirit of her words with me even still – as I reflect on my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate. = There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police. And friend, I know firsthand there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate, because no one should be above the law. My road to this moment was not easy. But I'm not sure that there’s anywhere except America where a little Black girl – the daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the '60s South – could have a story so filled with opportunities like these. And I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good, so that anyone can have a story of opportunity. name: Team Tuberville
subject: ICYMI: Coach’s GI Bill Benefits Legislation Approved
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tuberville for Senate, Inc
body:
Coach is hard at work to deliver on our nation’s promise >>>
| | | Peter,

Our nation’s veterans have made immeasurable sacrifices to defend our freedom, and our nation has made a commitment to take care of them and take care of their families.

Unfortunately, all too often they become the victims of federal government red tape as they seek to receive the benefits they rightly deserve.

**Coach has been leading the charge to streamline post-9/11 GI Bill benefits – and earlier this month, he scored a big win for America’s military veterans.**

S.3606, drafted by Coach to clarify the information required on Veterans Affairs (VA) and Department of Defense (DOD) forms filled out by a service member when transferring their post-9/11 GI Bill benefit to a dependent, has been passed by the U.S. Senate.

[**You can read more on the legislation here >>>**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/fae9e5dbaa50212d/00310230eef5448dc3d6b838967d376c/33013)

This is Coach’s second big win this year for our nation’s military families.

Back in April the Senate passed his “Supporting Families of the Fallen Act” to increase service members’ and veterans’ life insurance maximum coverage amounts, which had not been updated since 2005, from $400,000 to $500,000.

This is an issue near and dear to Coach’s heart, as the son of a World War II veteran and a grateful American. We’ll be sure to keep you posted on his ongoing work on behalf of our nation’s service members and veterans.
\- Team Tuberville

We talked all about her transition from campaign staffer to candidate, about her most impactful campaigns, raising kids while campaigning, highlights from her time in the White House, and obviously the lightning round (finally found a former press secretary who has an inbox like mine). Just a few miles outside of Downtown in the heart of Fifth Ward, a historic community where both Barbara Jordan and many of my family members called home, is now also known to be the home of a toxic environmental site tied to Union Pacific that is likely resulting in severe illnesses like cancer and preventable deaths. The Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) held a hearing in recent months regarding the potential approval of a permit being requested by Union Pacific, but no plans to fully remediate the contaminated area were presented.

The residents of the Fifth Ward are currently demanding that the **TCEQ** and the city hold Union Pacific accountable not just for mitigation of the toxic waste contamination of their site on Liberty Road but also for the extremely elevated levels of cancer that have devastated the surrounding area for years. The City Health Department has documented the _significantly disproportionate impact of cancer in this neighborhood_ , and many health and environmental experts agree _that contamination from Union Pacific’s site has most likely contributed_.

Residents want complete transparency around the testing that has and is being done to determine the exact extent of the problem. They absolutely deserve and have every right to this information. They also demand and deserve a full explanation of the steps that will be taken to mitigate the damage done and must be fully assured that these measures will be effective. There must be a comprehensive plan that requires Union Pacific to address and remediate the contamination in the area stemming from its site, including and beyond the confines of their site.

Last month, both Harris County and the City of Houston announced their intent to file a citizen suit against Union Pacific to require remediation efforts beyond just containment measures. As Houston’s next mayor, I will advocate for equitable outcomes that result in Houstonians remaining healthy – regardless of the Houston neighborhood where they live. clean_body: Houstonians deserve to be healthy – regardless of the Houston neighborhood where they live. | | | | | Team, Just a few miles outside of Downtown in the heart of Fifth Ward, a historic community where both Barbara Jordan and many of my family members called home, is now also known to be the home of a toxic environmental site tied to Union Pacific that is likely resulting in severe illnesses like cancer and preventable deaths. The Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) held a hearing in recent months regarding the potential approval of a permit being requested by Union Pacific, but no plans to fully remediate the contaminated area were presented. The residents of the Fifth Ward are currently demanding that the TCEQ and the city hold Union Pacific accountable not just for mitigation of the toxic waste contamination of their site on Liberty Road but also for the extremely elevated levels of cancer that have devastated the surrounding area for years. The City Health Department has documented the significantly disproportionate impact of cancer in this neighborhood , and many health and environmental experts agree that contamination from Union Pacific’s site has most likely contributed. Residents want complete transparency around the testing that has and is being done to determine the exact extent of the problem. They absolutely deserve and have every right to this information. They also demand and deserve a full explanation of the steps that will be taken to mitigate the damage done and must be fully assured that these measures will be effective. There must be a comprehensive plan that requires Union Pacific to address and remediate the contamination in the area stemming from its site, including and beyond the confines of their site. Last month, both Harris County and the City of Houston announced their intent to file a citizen suit against Union Pacific to require remediation efforts beyond just containment measures. As Houston’s next mayor, I will advocate for equitable outcomes that result in Houstonians remaining healthy – regardless of the Houston neighborhood where they live. Houstonians deserve to be healthy and safe in our city without exception. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Onward, Amanda K. We’ve got a big phone bank for a progressive fighter this Sunday.
#
Are you free on Sunday, Peter?
There aren’t many 2022 primaries left, but one we’re very focused on is Maxwell Frost’s primary in Florida's 10th Congressional District. Pramila and the Congressional Progressive Caucus have endorsed Maxwell — he faces a tough primary next week and we’re doing everything we can to help Maxwell win. He’s the candidate fighting for Medicare for All, a stronger social safety net, and an end to gun violence in America.
We hope you can join Team Frost and Team Pramila as we call voters to share Maxwell's story and get out the vote this Sunday! **[RSVP now for our virtual phone bank this Sunday, August 21 at 1pm Pacific / 4pm Eastern.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16162?utm_source=em20220818-1532&t=1&akid=1532%2E420207%2Ed10p60)**
**Virtual GOTV Phone Bank for Maxwell Frost**
THIS Sunday 8/21, 1pm Pacific / 4pm Eastern
**[More Info& Sign Up here](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16162?utm_source=em20220818-1532&t=2&akid=1532%2E420207%2Ed10p60)**
**[Make Calls for Maxwell »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16162?utm_source=em20220818-1532&t=3&akid=1532%2E420207%2Ed10p60)**
Maxwell Frost has spent his life as an organizer, fighting for the future we deserve. It’s time for poor, working-class, and young people to have a seat at the table. As the first Generation-Z member of Congress, from day one, Maxwell will fight to end gun violence, win Medicare For All, transform our racist criminal justice system, and end the climate crisis.
We need your help reaching out to the community to share Maxwell's mission and help him win in FL-10. **This midterm election year is about expanding our progressive caucus in Congress and ensuring Democrats keep the majority. So, your calls this weekend are critical.** **[Can you make calls for Maxwell along with Team Jayapal on Sunday, Peter?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16162?utm_source=em20220818-1532&t=4&akid=1532%2E420207%2Ed10p60)**
Even if you’ve never made calls before, we want to see you there — we will have training for first-timers and folks who need a refresher. We need all hands on deck!
We hope to see you there,
Team Jayapal

body:
KeithPekau.com |
---
| | [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=f477f10eb9&e=7dd0b93d07)

| |
---
| Peter,
This past week, Sean Casten and Nancy Pelosi passed Joe Biden’s ‘Inflation and Recession Act,’ which inflicts higher taxes on small businesses, adds 87,000 more IRS agents and will increase inflation especially on health care and drug prices. This bill will hurt Americans while we are in a recession.

This Casten-Pelosi-Biden “Don’t Say Inflation Act” will hurt the American people. It will not reduce inflation, the budget deficit or the world's temperature. Far from ‘looking out for the little guy,’ the bill is replete with socialist boondoggles and corporate welfare.

Sean Casten’s vote was a cruel one. Families are skipping meals, delaying retirement, and eating up their credit lines just to pay for daily essentials, yet Sean Casten just raised taxes on them. Inflation is not 0%. Food is up 12.9% this past year, while gas prices are up over 50% since Joe Biden took office.

He unleashes 87,000 new IRS agents on American taxpayers, targeting families, farmers, and small businesses. Friend, It’s clear that Brenda Siegel is the candidate who can truly represent all Vermonters. She’s worked for years to ensure that underrepresented voices have their seat at the table. As Governor, Brenda will bring in key voices including black and brown Vermonters, transgender folks, LGBTQIA+, indigenous people, the disability community, low and moderate income Vermonters, and young people into our democracy. **** If elected, Brenda would be the second woman Governor of Vermont. She would also be the first single mom and openly bisexual Governor to hold the office.
Most importantly, Brenda has a history of fighting for us. She’s worked with legislators on a state and Federal level to deliver real solutions to hard problems. She even slept on the Statehouse steps for 27 cold nights to ensure all Vermonters had access to housing. **** **We must elect Brenda Siegel as our next Governor because:** **** EVERYONE deserves to have food and shelter We need Vermont to be a safe haven for reproductive liberty We need a Governor who’s in touch with every day Vermonters We need real solutions to the housing, climate, child care and the overdose crises.

Did you see this? | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ed843407c36c/i-am-running-for-congress-9158754?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=0c300d2cee&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Hi there,

My opponent signed a letter Monday demanding an investigation into the FBI after they executed a search warrant on Trump’s Mar-A-Lago property. One that was, by all accounts, properly applied for by the FBI, and approved by the U.S. Attorney General and a federal judge prior to it being issued.

He doesn’t seem to care that Trump stands accused of being illegally in possession of highly classified documents and nuclear secrets — threatening our national security.

**Scott Fitzgerald and his right-wing extremist allies are doing everything they can to protect their party boss, and they’ll even attack law enforcement to advance their radical political agenda. Fitzgerald is only interested in backing the blue and law & order when it fits his political agenda.**

[**Can you rush a $50, $25, or even $10 donation to help us fight back today?**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=78ca42b77b&e=356c0699dd)

**Let’s be real: Fitzgerald is nowhere to be found when it comes to the real needs and issues Americans face every day.** Instead of working to restore our constitutional rights, like the right to privacy, fighting inflation, or working to restore manufacturing...Fitzgerald is actively obstructing the progress that we need here in Wisconsin.

My goal as your next Congressman is to ensure the kitchen table issues affecting all of us here at home are addressed and that everyone is held to the same set of rules. We need a leader who will not to constantly bend over backwards to undermine our Democracy and attack our criminal justice system while ignoring the needs of folks at home.

**[And that’s why I need your help](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a457200eae&e=356c0699dd) — I want to serve our state in the US Capitol, but we know they’re going to do everything they can to hold power for yet another term whether you want them to or not. **

Everyday hardworking Americans are struggling, and instead of taking swift action to improve the lives of our families, my opponent would rather let you suffer in hopes that it benefits him politically. [If you can, please contribute whatever you can so that I can work to fix our broken system in Washington.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=05304c6046&e=356c0699dd)

We can’t reward this behavior. It’s time to replace him.

Thank you,
Mike

body:
With less than three months left before the midterm election, we want to know what ways you’d like to volunteer with our movement.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220818-3308-header&t=1&akid=3308%2E2526796%2EGbDjau)
In case we haven’t already met — virtually or in-person — my name is Jeremy Parkin. I’m the Field Director for Team AOC and in charge of coordinating our volunteers and the programs that drive our on-the-ground work – from voter outreach, to partnerships with grassroots and local organizations. Nothing gets me more pumped than finding new ways our campaign can partner with communities in the district and across the country.
**And that includes you. Supporters like you are the backbone of our movement. Without you, none of our work would be possible. And that’s why I’m emailing you today.**
With less than three months left before the midterm general election, we want to know what ways you’d like to participate in and volunteer with our movement. So we’ve put together a short survey to gauge your interests and better serve you with volunteer opportunities that meet you where you are — no matter your experience level or where you’re located!
[Can you take a few minutes of your time today and fill out our Official Volunteer Survey? Your responses will inform our grassroots and volunteer programming leading up to Election Day and beyond.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/aoc-volunteer-interest?source=em20220818-3308-P_ORG_SUR_GRM&t=2&akid=3308%2E2526796%2EGbDjau)
**[Take the Survey in English](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/aoc-volunteer-interest?source=em20220818-3308-P_ORG_SUR_GRM&t=3&akid=3308%2E2526796%2EGbDjau)**
**[Realice la encuesta en español](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/aoc-volunteer-interest-es?source=em20220818-3308-P_ORG_SUR_GRM&t=4&akid=3308%2E2526796%2EGbDjau)**
Just a few minutes of your time today would greatly help inform the direction our organizing programs take as we head into election season.
I look forward to reading your responses. See you out there!
Jeremy Parkin
Field Director, Team AOC

| | | | | Peter, **According to Wyoming Republican primary voters, Liz Cheney is no longer right wing enough for the Republican Party. Her dad, Dick Cheney, was so influential when he was George W. So, instead, they nominated a confused, conspiracy-spouting dolt named Harriet Hageman (why do so many of their names sound made up?). **Hageman pushes the Big Lie, would've overturned the 2020 election for Trump and will surely try to steal future contests for Republicans. She believes women are baby containers belonging to the state, and a man entering a gun store talking to himself about shooting people should be able to buy an AR-15, no questions asked.**_ _ [**Can you join us in showing we won't give in to the extremists who ousted Cheney in WY for this cracked Q-Anon crazy, Hageman, and giving the incredible Lynnette Grey Bull $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford.** ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb1f291fc-6c3a-414a-84a8-34bce934ca73/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) It ain't easy winning in Wyoming as a Democrat.
